english.title: Fail to provide facility / information / document / record / other assistance to authorised fire and rescue employee
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being present on premises at **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), without reasonable excuse failed to comply with a requirement to provide **(..SPECIFY OFFICER..), an authorised officer exercising a power of entry to those premises for the purpose of

(A)_[obtaining information needed for the discharge of a fire and rescue authority's functions under section 7, 8 or 9 of the Fire and Rescue Services Act 2004,]_
(B)_[investigating what caused a fire in the premises or why it progressed as it did,]_

with the facilities, information, documents or records, or other assistance, that the officer reasonably requested in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 46(6)(b) and (7) of the Fire and Rescue Services Act 2004.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
failed to comply with a requirement under section 46(1)(b) / 46(2)(g) of the Fire and Rescue Services Act 2004
to provide a person exercising a power of entry with any facilities / information / documents / records / other assistance
that he / she may reasonably request

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
